name: headerLabel
label: Header Label
description: The title of the modal. This will be announced by screen readers

name: showModal
label: Open modal dialog
description: Option to open the modal dialog

name: preserveState
label: Preserve modal state
description: When true, the state of the content of the modal is preserved

name: displayOptions
label: Display options (advanced)
description: Modal display options allows users to add properties that are forwarded directly to the modal. For example, you can set { "size": "lg" } to control modal size. If using a bare modal, you can include properties such as { "disableDismiss": true } to remove the (X) functionality and { "enableFullscreenInMobile": true } to enable fullscreen mode on mobile devices.

name: viewportElementId
label: Viewport ID
description: Viewport component id to be rendered in the modal

name: viewportRoute
label: Viewport Route
description: Route to be rendered in the viewport inside the modal

name: viewportFields
label: Viewport Fields
description: Fields which are required to render the viewport contents in the modal

name: viewportParams
label: Viewport Params
description: Params which are optional to render the viewport contents in the modal
